Presented in excellent throughout, this attractive three-bedroom semi-detached home offers comfortable, modern living in a highly convenient location just a short stroll from the heart of Dromahair village and all local amenities. The accommodation includes two spacious double bedrooms, with the main bedroom benefiting from a stylish en-suite, along with a well-proportioned third bedroom, and a generous third bed room making it ideal for families, first-time buyers, or those seeking additional space. The property features gas-fired central heating, a private two-car driveway to the front, and a fully enclosed rear garden, perfect for children, pets, or outdoor entertaining. Combining an excellent location with a practical layout and move-in-ready condition, this is an ideal starter home, family residence, or investment property.
